title: Broken and covered in white powder.
text: Broken and covered in white powder.. This was not worth the time or money. When it finally arrived, it was broken I pulled it out of the bag and it was missing half of its leaves I tossed the broken one onto a chair to see the next and white powder puffed off of it. There was so much white powder on everything, me, the floor, the chair, inside the bag. I immediately packed it back up and sent it back.
